design_gotchas.title: Tight 3.6 V Absolute Maximum on VOUT & VEN <= VIN + 0.3 V Sequencing Limit
design_gotchas.detail: Table 6.1 on Page 5 restricts VOUT absolute maximum to ONLY 3.6 V (just 0.3 V above 3.3 V nominal!) and caps VEN at VIN + 0.3 V (operating EN <= VIN). Any external back-biasing of the 3.3 V rail above 3.6 V or driving EN high before VIN rises violates absolute maximum ratings.

design_gotchas.title: Capacitor-Free Operation Suffers Large Droop on Fast Load Steps (> 0.1 A/us)
design_gotchas.detail: Although TLV73333PDBVR is unconditionally stable with 0 uF CIN/COUT (eliminating startup inrush), Section 8.1.1 warns that load slew rates exceeding 0.1 A/us cause significant output voltage deviation unless an external 0.1–1 uF ceramic COUT is added (maximum recommended COUT is 100 uF).

design_gotchas.title: High-Frequency PSRR Drops to 28 dB at 100 kHz & Noise Is 120 uVRMS
design_gotchas.detail: While 100 Hz PSRR is 68 dB, PSRR falls to 35 dB at 10 kHz and 28 dB at 100 kHz with 120 uVRMS integrated noise — making TLV733P a poor choice for post-buck switching ripple rejection or sensitive RF/ADC rails compared to TPS7A20 (75 dB @ 100 kHz, 7 uVRMS).

design_gotchas.title: 228.4 C/W DBV Thermal Resistance Limits Full 300 mA Load From 5 V Input
design_gotchas.detail: At VIN = 5.0 V to VOUT = 3.3 V and 300 mA, PD = 510 mW causes ~116.5 °C rise on a JEDEC board (RθJA = 228.4 °C/W), restricting ambient temperature near room temp unless VIN is lower (e.g., 3.7–4.2 V Li-Ion) or copper area is enlarged.

typical_use_cases: Ultra-compact BOM-minimized 3.3 V digital rails needing capacitor-free zero-inrush startup
Single-cell Li-Ion to 3.3 V rails up to 300 mA benefiting from ultra-low 125 mV typical dropout
Space-constrained portable consumer and tablet sub-rails with ±1.4% max accuracy and 120 Ohm active discharge
Pin-compatible 300 mA SOT-23-5 replacement on 1=IN, 2=GND, 3=EN, 4=NC, 5=OUT boards when VIN <= 5.5 V and VEN <= VIN
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments TLV73333PDBVR is a capacitor-free 300 mA fixed 3.3 V (±1% typ, ±1.4% max over -40°C to +125°C) LDO in a 5-pin DBV SOT-23-5 package (1=IN, 2=GND, 3=EN active high, 4=NC, 5=OUT with 120 Ohm active discharge). Operating from 1.4 V to 5.5 V (6.0 V abs max), it delivers 125 mV typical dropout at 300 mA, 34 uA IQ, 0.1 uA shutdown current, and stable operation from 0 uF to 100 uF ceramic COUT. Designers must watch its strict 3.6 V VOUT abs max, VEN <= VIN + 0.3 V limit, modest high-frequency PSRR (28 dB at 100 kHz), and 228.4 °C/W RθJA.
